quantities: continuous nonnegative t; fixture input mass grid0.001t is not a decision lot size
constraints: initial and every arrival >= applicable reserve
stop_semantics: z = 1 iff q>0; q0 incurs no bunker fees or incremental bunker time

randomness: none; deterministic analytical/software fixtures, not holdout
